open_points.subject: credential-echo search in service answer bodies
open_points.text: K-10 says the kernel searches for “a credential echoed verbatim,” while A09 rule 7 searches only for “the bytes of the credential value sent with the request.”
open_points.question: Must an answer body, including a file body, be searched only for the credential sent on that request, or for every service credential or token known to the installation?
options: Search only for the credential value sent with that request
Search for every configured service credential
Search for every configured service credential and owner or agent token
open_points.default_guess: Search only for the credential value sent with that request, following A09 rule 7.
